info.name: FleetBooks API
info.description: Set baseUrl (e.g. http://139.59.3.23 or http://192.168.5.28:8000) and the logins under Variables, then run folder '1. Smoke test'. It logs in, saves the tokens and checks each answer. Uses demo logins by default (python manage.py seed_demo); it creates and deletes one test customer.

item.name: 1. Smoke test
item.description: Run in order: logs in, checks every main flow and the security rules.

exec: pm.test("has board and attention", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("board"); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("attention"); });
pm.test("no company money in driver answers", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text().toLowerCase()).to.not.include("profit"));

item.name: Office user blocked from driver API → 403
2. All endpoints
item.description: Every endpoint. Log in first (Smoke test → Office login / Driver login), then set the id / pk / key variables.

item.name: GET /api/auth/business/ — Business name, address, GST… printed on reports
PUT /api/auth/business/ — Business name, address, GST… printed on reports
GET /api/auth/me/ — Who am I: user, role, and what the role may see or change
GET /api/driver/dashboard/ — Driver home: name, vehicle, current trip, month stats, unread notifications
POST /api/driver/expenses/ — Submit an expense (starts Pending, needs office approval)
GET /api/driver/form-options/ — Choices for the driver forms: my vehicle, my trips, categories, fuel types…
POST /api/driver/fuel/ — Add fuel (Litres × Rate, counts straight away)
GET /api/driver/maintenance/{id}/ — One of my problem reports
PATCH /api/driver/profile/ — Update my profile (office-only fields like name and salary are ignored)
GET /api/driver/trips/{id}/ — One of my trips (404 if it isn't mine)
POST /api/driver/trips/{id}/complete/ — Complete a trip (KM = end − start odometer)
POST /api/driver/trips/{id}/start/ — Start a trip (vehicle becomes On Trip)
POST /api/driver/trips/{id}/update/ — Add notes or a document during a trip
GET /api/driver/vehicle/ — My vehicle, its documents and assignment history
GET /api/office/assign-trip/ — Trips without a driver, and the drivers who can take them
POST /api/office/assign-trip/ — Assign a trip to a driver (the driver is notified)
GET /api/office/dashboard/ — Office home: today on the road, needs attention, month ledger, driver numbers
POST /api/office/drivers/{id}/account/ — Create, reset, activate or deactivate a driver's app login
POST /api/office/drivers/{id}/assign-vehicle/ — Assign a vehicle to a driver (history is kept)
GET /api/office/drivers/{id}/overview/ — Driver profile, month numbers, salary, trips, fuel, expenses, reports, history
GET /api/office/expense-approvals/ — Driver expenses waiting for approval, and recently reviewed ones
POST /api/office/expenses/{id}/decide/ — Approve or reject a driver expense
GET /api/office/r/{key}/ — List a module with search, filters, period and totals
POST /api/office/r/{key}/ — Add a record (fields from /api/office/resources/; multipart or JSON)
POST /api/office/r/{key}/{id}/ — Save changes (only the fields sent change)
PATCH /api/office/r/{key}/{id}/ — Save changes (only the fields sent change)
DELETE /api/office/r/{key}/{id}/ — Delete (refused with 400 when linked records exist)
GET /api/office/resources/ — Definitions of every module the role may open (fields, choices, filters, totals)
GET /api/monthly-finance/ — Monthly finance: income, expenses, EMI, profit
GET /api/reports/{key}/ — Run a report (JSON), or download it with export=pdf|xlsx
